mission: Build the data and deployment infrastructure for physical AI, starting in Egypt. Precise, honest footage of real work, collected fast and at scale, so robots learn from the real world.

values.s: Focus and discipline in every task. Every 30-minute window shapes the dataset.
Radical honesty. No shortcuts, no fake footage, no lazy camera work.
Feedback is fuel. Anyone, at any level, says what they see.
Fix it on the floor, now. Don't wait for a layer above you.
Treat every phone, mount, and cap as if you paid for it.
Full responsibility for your domain, and help for your teammates.
Performance and initiative open doors here without a ceiling.

how: Vound in the United States sells training footage to robotics labs. KMSC in Egypt collects it: workers wear head-mounted phones that record first-person video of real work in factories, hotels, warehouses, construction sites, and farms.

starts.line: Two hours of training. Then you run ten phones.
Your book, your sites, your number every night.
How the company works, end to end.
